# Long horizons (72 h, 168 h): validation (generated by `scripts/run_long_horizons.py`)

Git commit `070af0a113`. Scenario A, same samples for all models, 3 seeds, mean prediction. MAE in MW. Hyper-parameters chosen on validation; early stopping on validation (mildly optimistic).

## Horizon 72 h (train samples 19,803; validation samples 4,367)

| model | validation MAE (MW) |
|---|---:|
| persistence | 6,828 |
| snaive_same_hour_3_or_7_days | 6,828 |
| snaive168 | 6,432 |
| ridge | 5,266 |
| xgboost S4 | 4,889 |
| LSTM L4 | 5,487 |

Selected: ridge ridge_full_rel alpha 100; XGBoost best of 30 trials, trees [272, 419, 439]; LSTM best of 12 trials (hidden 64, lr 0.003244, dropout 0.05), epochs [2, 1, 1].
